Author: brady.woods
Name: Sticker Chat
Punchline: Turns auto-translate phrases into stickers over players' heads.
Description:
When someone sends a chat message made up only of auto-translate phrases, replaces their native chat bubble with a sticker image. Mapping is 1:1 and user configurable. Receive-only: this plugin never sends chat.

Stickers live in packs, which are stamped with the character that authored them and can be shared as a zip file or an https link. Players without the plugin just see an ordinary auto-translate phrase.

Alpha: bubble replacement works and is confirmed in-game, but expect rough edges. Use /stickerchat to configure and /stickerchat debug to inspect bubble nodes.
